review.gallery: Eight native Dunes brochure renders visually matched to the community, including three interior scenes. Hero and card use the same own exterior. The source link opens Binghatti’s archive containing the original Dunes PDF.
review.location: Both official brochure page 19 panels publish the same six estimates. The map shows Dunes cluster scope. The project site gives different Meydan and Downtown estimates, qualified on the page. Its map uses a name query only.
review.floorPlans: The original Dunes and Oasis pages 9 and 10 render identically at 4,200 pixels. Page 9 carries the exact 2,773.00 sq ft BUA table and isometric. Page 10 contains ground, first, second and roof. Three Binghatti site drawings and five attributed broker images cover larger typologies. The 7 BR drawings are numbered as published without guessing levels.

unavailable: Separate public primary PDF books for the larger villas were not established. Their drawings do not print built-up area. Broker sales area and built-up figures conflict by definition or revision and are not used as plan measurements.
No verified entrance coordinates or separate public plans for the highest mansion category were established.
